additional_info.subject: High Priority - Remove QR code on the screen
additional_info.body:
Hi Ferdi,
This is a high-priority issue. We had a customer who scanned the QR code on the screen at the Ruakura chargers and got scammed. She was a first-time user of our charger where she followed instructions on how to use the charger but when she scanned the QR code on the screen, she went into dodgy websites. Can you please remove these QR codes appearing on the charger screens for both chargers? Thanks
Kind regards,
Antonio Garais Jr
We.EV Project Engineer

additional_info.body:

Of course, we can proceed to remove the screensaver images.
These QR codes are attached to the image being displayed on the screensaver of the charger.
These images were provided to us by your team. (See images attached).
